title: unalloc: find the AI spend nobody owns
description:
unalloc joins OpenCost Kubernetes allocations with LiteLLM, OpenAI and Anthropic billing data into one Decimal-exact ledger and reports the share of AI spend with no owner.

This archive includes five reproducible case studies of inference cost attribution (a vLLM-style serving simulator, real PyTorch KV-cache inference, tensor- and pipeline-parallel inference on torch.distributed, an end-to-end run against mock provider APIs, and downstream use cases) and the accompanying paper, Who Pays for the KV Cache? Attributing Shared AI Inference Spend Across Kubernetes and LLM Provider Bills.
